envelope.description: Add the lowest-number duplicate tie-break, gated on the findIssues amendment

body.title: Add the lowest-number duplicate tie-break, gated on the findIssues amendment
body.summary: Add step 5 of ensureUnitIssueDetailed: after recording, list every issue carrying the unit label through port.findIssues, adopt the lowest-numbered issue, record it in place of its own, comment on and close its own as a duplicate, and keep the created issue when the listing fails. The build starts this task only after the sc1 findIssues amendment (AMD-315d510cb28100e2-10) is agreed with s1; until then it is exercised against a fake port that implements findIssues.
acceptanceChecks: A listing with a lower-numbered issue makes the call adopt it, comment on and close its own; a failing close still adopts.
Two simulated daemons that both create before either lists end with one open issue, the lowest, and both records name it.
A failed listing keeps the created issue and returns ok with duplicateCheck not-run.

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/unit-issue.test.ts: a lower-numbered issue is adopted and the call's own is commented on and closed, even when the close fails
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/unit-issue.test.ts: two simulated daemons that both create converge on the lowest issue
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/unit-issue.test.ts: a failed findIssues listing keeps the recorded issue and a following call makes no tracker call
